status: post-step contact wrench is a model estimate, not solver-force readback or calibrated force

source_audit.force_law: _compute_body_particle_contact_force: normal penalty ke*penetration, approach damping from relative displacement divided by dt, and projected isotropic friction
source_audit.contact_material_initialization: init_body_particle_contacts stores averaged material ke/kd/mu and seeds per-contact AVBD penalty k
source_audit.within_step_penalty_update: update_duals_body_particle_contacts changes the per-contact penalty as solver iterations proceed
source_audit.force_evaluation: particle_vbd_kernels.py and rigid_vbd_kernels.py evaluate using body_particle_contact_penalty_k and cached damping/friction

repository_estimator.stiffness_used: static average of model soft_contact_ke and rigid shape_material_ke
repository_estimator.damping_and_friction: Newton VBD cached per-contact material values when available
repository_estimator.position_and_velocity: post-step unified contact manifold plus current/previous state geometry
repository_estimator.classification: kinematic instrument load estimate; not independent sensor data

consequence: The estimate follows Newton's contact-law form but differs from the exact within-iteration solver force because its stiffness coefficient omits the per-contact AVBD penalty updates. Do not interpret the channel as calibrated tactile force.
privacy: No source video, image, credential, absolute user path, or personal metadata is recorded.
